rows.name: Git tree · the run page
rows.why: The tree fills the screen, oldest at the top. The Next bar shows the ways out of the current step. A tap on a row opens a sheet over the dimmed tree, which does not move. The sheet shows the result and the actions, with a step back.

sketches.caption: W4 at Review · full tree, Next bar
Tap on Test pass 1 · overlay sheet

rows.name: Git tree · a long run
rows.why: A long run has 34 step runs, 3 Review rounds and 2 step backs. Done parts fold into one row, or the whole tree stays open with a position bar. Step backs and failures stay visible in all three forms.
